title: A Current for the Rivergate
author: Silas Amberdale
blurb: Wren Voss, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
